_comment: G1 race saddle ids (UmaExtractor win_saddle_id_array space = master.mdb single_mode_wins_saddle.id). Derived authoritatively: single_mode_wins_saddle rows with win_saddle_type==3 are exactly the single G1-race saddles (each maps to one race_instance whose race.grade==100); type 0 = compound TITLES (Triple Crown/Tiara/Grand Prix — mechanics-notes §8: title→0), type 2 = G2, type 1 = G3, all correctly excluded. ids 147/148/153/155 are alternate-scenario saddles for Takarazuka Kinen/Kikka Sho/Tenno Sho (Spring)/Satsuki Sho (all G1). Re-derive on a data refresh via the node:sqlite snippet in docs/provenance.md §5. P5 hand-patchable; keep src/features/inheritance/g1_saddle_ids.json in sync (g1SaddleIdsSync.test.ts).
